notes: Sheets: drawing sheets inside the model. Viewports showing a scene or a view of their own, worked inside, with a locked scale, their own style, switches and projection. Title panels, text, dimension and leader styles, line types; dimensions and labels tied to the model; drawing on sheets; renders, pictures and PDF pages kept in the model; batch plot to PDF, DWG or pictures. The Assistant can make and plot sheets. New 2D tools for the model: Trim Lines, Extend Lines, Round Corners 2D (fillet and chamfer), Array, Ellipse and Curve. Polar tracking settings; Rotate measures from its reference line in any plane.
